name: Hime Ningyou Tai Yuusha
source: Hayao Yamazaki is a Japanese university student summoned to a fantasy world to become a hero, but while trying to defeat the evil witch, he is taken captive by a living doll. He must defeat her in erotic battles in order to escape.
translation: 日本大学生山崎隼夫被召唤到幻想世界当勇者。然而，在试图击败邪恶女巫时，他被一具活人偶俘虏。为了逃脱，他必须在色情战斗中击败她。
